heading: Where I've built
description: Roles where I built and shipped real production systems.

roles.subtitle: AI microservices, LLM integration, and Python ecosystem projects under the VP of Technology
bullets: Rebuilt a loan processing pipeline that crashed past 300 concurrent loans into one stably handling 6,000+ with AsyncIO.
Cut batch runtime 95% from over 30 minutes to under 2 minutes across around 800K rows per run.
Eliminated a MySQL query bottleneck, cutting query latency from 80 seconds to 7 seconds at high concurrency.
Scaled backend task processing by adding async workers and queues, improving throughput and reducing latency.
Owned 3 projects, driving database schema decisions and feature building while independently fixing production bugs.
Built and shipped 2 Tier-1 bank integrations end to end with idempotent data contracts for critical transactions.
Spearheaded the end to end build of a FastAPI speech to text and translation service with Gemini API summaries.
Benchmarked open source and cloud transcription models and selected Fast Whisper for production.
Built a rule based policy engine letting investors define custom rules to analyze and assess loan risk.
Developed CRON driven async workers for event driven automation, anomaly detection, and reporting.
Migrated the multi-tenant reconciliation engine to Python, aligning it with the core backend stack.
Modernized the OCR pipeline with upgraded text extraction, image transformation, and PII masking for image and PDF.

roles.subtitle: Client projects on Linux production infrastructure
bullets: Built and maintained deployment pipelines for 16+ production client environments on Linux infrastructure.
Delivered new client projects from scratch and updated existing ones to meet evolving client requirements.
Handled production troubleshooting, server configuration, system updates, and security across client environments.

roles.subtitle: Training internship, basic Python to advanced Django across multiple modules
bullets: Built RESTful APIs with Django REST Framework and token based authentication.
Modeled data with Django ORM and managed it through customized Django Admin.
Built NumPy and Pandas pipelines to clean raw datasets and render Chart.js visualizations.
